dialogues.jp: 足音を立てないように、ゆっくりと角を曲がる。
dialogues.en: "Is there someone famous there? ......Is it Tom Jones?"
dialogues.text: "Is there someone famous there? ......Is it Tom Jones?"

dialogues.jp:
視線の先では、白い物体が住宅街の中を悠然と
闊歩している。
dialogues.en: The people looking were all old ladies.
dialogues.text: The people looking were all old ladies.

dialogues.jp:
にわかには受け入れがたい光景だが、そんなこ
とを言っていては、奴の住処を突き止めること
なんてできやしない。
dialogues.en: "Let me see......"
dialogues.text: "Let me see......"

dialogues.jp:
神への生贄として供されることの多い生き物と
は思えないほどの凶悪な目をした白い悪魔――
ヤギ。
dialogues.en:
I pushed into the crowd of old ladies while laughing at my
rubber-neck spirit. Arrg, the smell of strong perfume....
dialogues.text:
I pushed into the crowd of old ladies while laughing at my
rubber-neck spirit. Arrg, the smell of strong perfume....

dialogues.jp:
こいつの謎を解き明かせば、ななこも少しは救
われるはずだ。
dialogues.en: Fweeeeet!
dialogues.text: Fweeeeet!

dialogues.jp:
……別に、個人的興味に駆られているわけじゃ
ないぞ、多分。
dialogues.en: (What's that?)
dialogues.text: (What's that?)

dialogues.jp: ……っと、まぁそれはそれとして、だ。
dialogues.en:
The old ladies started moving around at the sound of a
whistle!
dialogues.text:
The old ladies started moving around at the sound of a
whistle!

dialogues.jp:
つかず離れず、というのはなかなかに神経を使
う。
dialogues.en: "Ow, that hurts!"
dialogues.text: "Ow, that hurts!"

dialogues.jp: 余計なことを考えていると途端に見失いそうだ。
dialogues.en: "Arrgg!"
dialogues.text: "Arrgg!"

dialogues.jp: 標的が次の角を曲がる。
dialogues.en: "Arrrggg....... Help me......"
dialogues.text: "Arrrggg....... Help me......"

dialogues.jp: 少し速度を上げて俺もその角を曲がる。
dialogues.en: Ah, I can see my dead dog waving at me......
dialogues.text: Ah, I can see my dead dog waving at me......

dialogues.en: Ah, dead Suginami's waving at me......
dialogues.text: Ah, dead Suginami's waving at me......

dialogues.jp: いない！？
dialogues.en: "Arrgg!"
dialogues.text: "Arrgg!"

dialogues.jp: 周囲を見回してみても、白い影さえもない。
dialogues.en: I was thrown out of the crowd like a ball.
dialogues.text: I was thrown out of the crowd like a ball.

dialogues.jp: 消えた……？
dialogues.en: My friend was offering me his hand to help me up.
dialogues.text: My friend was offering me his hand to help me up.

dialogues.jp: そんな……あんな一瞬で？
dialogues.en: "......I wanted to say 'Oh shit!' when I die......"
dialogues.text: "......I wanted to say 'Oh shit!' when I die......"

dialogues.jp:
しかも、このタイミングは、気付かれていたと
しか思えない……。
dialogues.en: "Suginami......"
dialogues.text: "Suginami......"

dialogues.jp: ……侮りがたし、ヤギ。
dialogues.en:
We held our hands together. Then I felt something warm like
tears...
dialogues.text:
We held our hands together. Then I felt something warm like
tears...

dialogues.jp: ◆侮れない◆
dialogues.en: ◆The sale war◆
dialogues.text: ◆The sale war◆

dialogues.jp: 偶然見かけた白い悪魔を追いかけた俺……。
dialogues.en:
I saw a crowd of old ladies at the promenade. They were
there for a sale, but it looked like a war......
dialogues.text:
I saw a crowd of old ladies at the promenade. They were
there for a sale, but it looked like a war......

dialogues.jp: だが、一瞬の隙にまかれてしまった。
dialogues.en: "......What's happening over there?"
dialogues.text: "......What's happening over there?"

dialogues.jp: 侮りがたし……。
dialogues.en: There was a crowd of people on one corner of the promenade.
dialogues.text: There was a crowd of people on one corner of the promenade.
